eyebrow: A LITTLE FIX. A BETTER FLOW.
headline: Wrong layout.
description: Bring your text back to the language you meant to type.
inputPlaceholder:
Paste or type your text here…
متن خود را اینجا وارد کنید…
outputPlaceholder: Your corrected text will appear here.
privacy: Your text is processed locally on your device.
shortcutDescription: Select text, or put the caret at the end of a line, then press your shortcut.
candidateDescription: The result is uncertain. Review a candidate before applying it.
heuristic: These scores are local heuristics, not probabilities.
settingsDescription: A quiet utility, tuned to your workflow.
launchAtStartupHelp: Starts the Rust core and tray without opening a window.
minimizeToTrayHelp: Releases the editor window; shortcuts keep working.
preferredHelp: Choose up to 32 layouts for Auto Fix. No selection uses your loaded Windows layouts.
noLayouts: No layouts available. Open the desktop app or install a keyboard layout in Windows Settings.
shortcutHelp: Use Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win with a letter, number, Space, Enter, Tab or F1–F24. Conflicts are checked when saving.
restoreHelp: Restores text, rich text and supported images. Owner-only clipboard metadata is skipped; newer clipboard data is kept.
thresholdHelp: Automatic replacement also requires common word evidence and a clear lead over other results.
debugHelp: Show operational error codes in About. User text and clipboard contents are never logged.
aboutDescription: PIMXSWAP repairs text using the physical keys behind your Windows keyboard layouts.
privateBody: No accounts, no cloud processing, no hidden telemetry. Conversion and language scoring work offline.
engineBody: Reads real Windows layouts, including Shift, Caps Lock and AltGr. Characters that cannot be mapped stay intact.
limitsBody: Language scores are conservative hints. IMEs, password fields, elevated apps and unusual copy/paste behavior may require manual conversion. Some dead-key sequences cannot be reconstructed uniquely from text.
resourceNote: The background core is event driven. Resource usage depends on Windows and WebView2; validate it on your own system.
welcomeDescription: A quick way back from the wrong keyboard layout. Three small steps, then you're ready.
chooseLanguagesDescription: Choose from all keyboard layouts available on Windows. Search by language or layout name.
setShortcutDescription: Select text or place the cursor after a word in another app and press Auto Fix.
native_required: Windows integration is available in the PIMXSWAP desktop app. Run npm run tauri dev to use it.
layout_unavailable: A selected keyboard layout is no longer loaded. Refresh the layouts.
text_too_large: This text is too large. Convert a smaller selection.
hotkey_collision: A shortcut is reserved by another app. Choose a different combination.
duplicate_hotkey: Each action needs a different shortcut.
invalid_hotkey: That shortcut format is not supported.
hotkey_init_failed: Global shortcuts could not be registered.
clipboard_busy: The clipboard is busy. Try again in a moment.
clipboard_unsupported: Your clipboard contains a format that cannot be safely preserved. Copy it elsewhere or use the internal editor.
clipboard_too_large: The clipboard is too large to safely preserve.
clipboard_changed: Another app changed the clipboard. The operation was stopped.
clipboard_write_failed: The clipboard could not be updated.
selection_unavailable: Unable to access selected text. Try copying it manually into PIMXSWAP.
selection_changed: The original selection changed. Select it again and retry.
selection_expired: This selection has expired. Select the text and press the shortcut again.
focus_changed: The active window changed. Select the text and try again.
input_blocked: Windows blocked input to this app. Use manual copy and paste.
modifiers_held: Release the modifier keys and try again.
settings_read_failed: Saved settings could not be read.
startup_failed: The Windows startup setting could not be updated.
choose_layouts: Choose your source and target layouts in Settings first.
busy: A selection operation is already running.
invalid_candidate: This candidate is no longer available.
window_failed: The editor window could not be opened.
tray_failed: The system tray could not be updated.
unknown_error: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
